findings.title: Stale resumed/has_activity when started_at changes
findings.problem: DERIVE_SQL derives resumed from session_dims.started_at, but facts are only derived by the refresher batch and maintenance for NULL facts. If started_at changes through an ingest binding with no new rollup key, or session_usage is written outside the refresher, a stale false fact makes the admitted-arms filter drop sessions the rule would admit.
findings.impact: Sessions silently missing from the Sessions list and its total. Reachability was not confirmed, since the writers of started_at were not traced.
findings.recommendation: Re-derive the facts wherever started_at is updated, or compare the stored start day inside the arm predicate; otherwise document the staleness window.
